claim_ceiling: In the registered two-agent B1 host, the ordered joiner-to-waiter action/consequence edge and later-record update were expressive, but correctly associated intact credit produced exactly no bounded-utility or fixed-token allocation gain over ordinary GAE at every root. The positive intact-versus-registered-cut contrast cannot identify waiter identity because the cut also flips type/generic supervision. No association-specific algorithm value, end-to-end variable-k, fixed-k superiority, multi-update, learned-estimator, UAV, or general credit claim is supported; the bounded null is not a general impossibility theorem.
completed_summary: Selected no new executable observation. B1 already answers the decision-relevant intact-versus-GAE allocation/utility contrast with exact root-wise equality, while static inspection shows kappa depends on type and lag but not waiter identity and the registered cut holds older_id fixed while swapping opposite type. A cue-preserving identity-only control is inert in B1; a meaningful test needs a genuinely different host plus independent oracle headroom. Prepared a traceable evidence packet and preliminary PARK recommendation for independent Convergence.
next_action: Send exactly one different fresh Convergence transport only the frozen synthesis evidence packet and public baseline refs, archive its complete natural response, then disposition every material objection before REVIEW_RESOLVED.
next_discriminator: Reentry prerequisite: independently identify a host with at least two consequence-distinct eligible waiter identities inside the same generic pre-action/cue stratum and prospectively demonstrate same-information oracle scarce-allocation and bounded-utility headroom over ordinary GAE; only then test a cue/sign-preserving wrong-waiter key derangement in a new material cycle.
